name: Thessaly
subtitle: the upward rain
story: On Thessaly the rain goes up. It lifts off the sea in thin threads and gathers in shallow pools on the undersides of the clouds, which catch the light at dusk. People wear their umbrellas on their feet and buy boots that are waterproof on top. The weather app has one setting: from below. The pools in the sky all have names, and the argument about which is deepest is three hundred years old.
hook: A planet for people who check the weather app ten times a day.
beats: On Thessaly the rain falls up, out of the sea and into the clouds.
So umbrellas go on your feet, and boots are waterproof on top.

beats.text: Because here, the rain goes up.

Nobody on Thessaly has ever had
a bad hair day.
Everyone has damp knees.

The forecast hasn't changed
in three hundred years.

Rosa checks it ten times a day.
She doesn't trust it.

Everyone had their first
bad hair day.

Only one umbrella
was the right way up.

She let in the three
who'd laughed loudest.

episode.caption:
Rosa is in the first frame, before anyone mentions her.

The rain on Thessaly lifts off the sea in thin threads and gathers in shallow pools on the undersides of the clouds, which turn gold at dusk. Every pool has a name, and the argument about which is deepest is three hundred years old. Umbrellas are worn feet-first from October to March, and boots are waterproof on top. People now date things 'before the Down' and 'after the Down'.

On my first day I held my umbrella over my head too. Rosa was the only one who didn't laugh. She has not said 'I told you so'. She's had it embroidered on a cushion.

The forecast now reads: from below. Probably.

300,000 people, a 23-hour day, 0.6 g. The rain rides a steady updraft off the warm sea. (On Earth, an updraft of about 90 km/h can hold a golf-ball-sized hailstone in the air.) That afternoon, Thessaly's dropped for most of an hour.

What do you always carry just in case?

short.title:
Your umbrella
goes on your feet.
short.sub:
You've just landed on Thessaly.
The rain falls up.

beats.text:
Your hair stays perfect.
Your knees don't.

Then, this afternoon,
it rains down.
